name: outlook-email
description: Work with Outlook Email using the configured Microsoft Outlook app connector.

interface.longDescription: Use Outlook Email to triage inboxes, summarize threads, extract actions, and draft replies or forwards through the connected Microsoft Outlook app.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the most recent thread with procurement and pull the exact questions they asked so I can answer cleanly
Draft a reply to the latest customer message: acknowledge the concern, set expectations, and offer two ways forward
Find the top 5 emails I should respond to today based on urgency, seniority, and deadlines; include one-line suggested replies
